research_rationale:
EO 8402 (May 7, 1940, Franklin D. Roosevelt) is a one-paragraph exemption order read in full in the held American Presidency Project transcription (Wayback capture; a provisional working text, grade mirror_transcription). The page record's heading names the number and its date and subject agree with the text. Its only operative command, under section 204 of the act of June 30, 1932, exempts Nelson S. Thompson from compulsory retirement for age for a stated term: "I hereby exempt the said Nelson S. Thompson from compulsory retirement for age for a period of one year ending September 30, 1941.". The term ends September 30, 1941 by its own words. Later exemption orders for the same person are later events and new grants; none revokes or shortens this order.
